subject: Texas AI Docket, Carousel No. 8, August 26th, 2026, The billion buys no building. UT Dell Medical Center, Phase 1
body:
The billion buys no building. UT Dell Medical Center, Phase 1

Carousel No. 8, August 26th, 2026

Shipped at 7.282

claimsPASS, 33 verified claim(s), every quotation checked character by character by three judges
renderPASS, 9 slide(s), 0 error(s)
qaPASS, 0 fail(s)
aggregatesPASS, every computed figure declared and re-derived
sources blockPASS, 27 claim id(s) across 5 document(s), every id resolves
assemblyPASS, 9 slide(s), vector text, titled from copy.json
ship imagesPASS, 23.72 MB to 3.18 MB, quality 40.1 to 45.8 dB against a 40.0 floor
panel readyPASS, the new gate that runs before any scorer
scorePASS, 7.282 against a 6.8 threshold, round 3 of 5, no hard fail from any judge
dossiersPASS
captionPASS
craft floorPASS
plan vs renderPASS
ledgersPASS, the three variety ledgers agree with their own entries
shipped runsPASS, 8 shipped run(s), every applicable gate clean on the artifacts as committed
sitePASS, 389 pages byte fresh against a temp dir rebuild
completionPASS, run_complete exits 0

What degraded

  • THE LIGHT DECK CAP IS BREACHED AND WAIVED. brand.yaml allows a light deck at most once per eight runs and says the ledger enforces the count. It never did: every light_decks_used value read the literal 1 while meaning light FRAMES inside a deck. Measured off the shipped PNGs, 08-18 is at deck median L* 82.7, 08-20 at 85.5 and this deck at 86.7, three light decks in eight against a cap of one, two of them already shipped before anyone counted. A reader judge called it a hard fail and the measurement agrees. Waived on the owner's instruction, and ledger_check now counts it off the render so the cap binds from here.
  • THREE SCORING ROUNDS WHERE ONE SHOULD HAVE DONE. Rounds 1 and 2 spent nine model calls finding things a measurement finds for nothing, and both of round 2's hard fails were manufactured by round 1's own repairs. panel_ready.py and Phase 14b went to main this run so the next deck cannot reach a scorer in that state.
  • The angle repeats the shape of two recent decks. 08-22 was 'whose text never uses the words data center' and 08-19 was 'the two different wordings one office gave the same instruction on one day'. Two panels found it and none could fail it, because the dedupe gate compares topic, entities and keywords and never reads the angle field it stores. Written into topics.json as an upgrade lane proposal.
  • The caption closes on a question one run after 08-25 closed on a question. No exclusion list could have stopped it: ledger_check derives those lists from the entries BEFORE the newest, so while 08-25 was the newest its own move was excluded by design and today's room was never handed it. Tomorrow's room will have it.
  • The turn does not stand on its own. Frames 1 to 5 are a capital finance story and never use the word AI, then frame 6 opens on searching for it. The quote that makes the search mean something is on frame 9, and the bridge exists only in the caption. Two judges named it. Moving a frame this late is what manufactured two hard fails earlier in this run, so it is next run's opening work rather than tonight's.
  • No county on the deck. Four fetched documents were searched and none names one, and brand.yaml makes a county first coordinates footer fixed on every deck. The collision is the owner's call and is written up rather than resolved by inferring a county.
  • The planned value arc did not ship. The storyboard puts the turn on the deck's brightest frame and slide 6 measures 70.6 median L against slide 5 at 91.4. The per frame acceptance passed because it asks only that the span be the lightest region on its own frame.
  • The August 31st House Bill 3512 compliance deadline is not in the record, because dir.texas.gov disallows this project's agent for the whole host and the decision is to respect it.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it The billion buys no building. UT Dell Medical Center, Phase 1, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

The billion buys no building.

On August 12th the UT System Regents approved adding Phase 1 of the UT Dell Medical Center in Austin to the capital improvement program, at "a total project cost for Phase I of $1,000,000,000". The first line of the board's own cost table reads "Building Cost $0". The money is dirt and drawings.

Nine frames on what the board approved, what its own item says, and the one word that item never uses.

The billion is borrowed. The board's own background says it is "expected to be repaid from clinical revenues", which is what a hospital earns from treating patients. The committee's twenty pages are public and they never use the word AI. What would you read them for?

#UTSystem #DellMedicalCenter #MDAnderson

2. The first comment

https://communityimpact.com/northwest-austin/development/ut-board-of-regents-approves-first-phase-of-the-ut-dell-medical-center/

On the search. Artificial intelligence, the standalone word AI, machine learning and algorithm were searched case-insensitively across all 20 pages of the committee's document and returned nothing. The same four terms return 24 matches on 16 pages of the 307 pages of the combined book. Both documents were fetched and read on August 26th, 2026.

The words the item does use for the technology are quoted whole on slide 7, beside the university's own words for the same building.

The machine changed itself

  • scripts/carousel/panel_ready.py and Phase 14b of the routine, both merged to main
    A gate between the deck and the panel. Six checks, none about taste. On its first run it found six stale dossiers, the drift two judges had reported by hand. The sharpest check: qa.py skips data-decorative nodes BEFORE the occlusion and contrast checks, and this deck had that attribute on every MODELED disclosure and every source attribution, so it had exempted its own honesty labels from its own gates.
  • copy_sync_check gains a QUOTATIONS direction
    Every phrase a frame sets as a source's own words must occur verbatim in a quote on a claim THAT SLIDE DECLARES. Slide 7 printed a board quotation that is in no claim, and claims_check, noun_trace and copy_sync_check were all green because all three were reading the same authored string.
  • caption_check reads the whole linkedin_post block from brand.yaml
    This run's caption ran 1,970 characters through five panels against a configured 300 to 900 band and the gate printed clean every time.
  • the aggregates row says what was counted on each side
    It read '8 declared and re-derived' over a file declaring 7, and two of three judges nearly logged a defect that did not exist.
  • sources_block agrees with itself on number
    It shipped 'one news reports' into the first comment, and its own self-test asserted that string rather than catching it. A self-test written against what the code produces rather than what it should produce freezes the defect.
  • NOT LANDED, and logged with the reason: a prose half to the dossier staleness check
    A word overlap check fired on slide 6, whose dossier is accurate but abstracts the frame rather than repeating it. A gate that misreports costs more than one that misses, so the unsound check came out rather than shipping behind a green banner.

Each reverts on its own commit.

Notes

THE RECORD. The worklist held 40 items due and 6 rotten and was cleared in full, with nothing deferred. reverify.py --apply stamped 10 across two passes. The other 30 needed a person, because the diff tool reads neither a PDF nor a ZIP nor a page that wants a browser User-Agent, and that is most of what this record cites. All 30 were fetched, every claim tested against the live page, and every item stamped with a dated movement line. ADMITTED, EIGHT ITEMS, every one on a primary source and every one naming where it happened. The UT System Regents putting the first billion dollars of the UT Dell Medical Center into the capital program. Senate Water, Agriculture and Rural Affairs taking up data center cooling water on September 1st. The first annual cycle of the AI training Texas now requires of state and local government employees. An NSF funded Rice laboratory where a model designs the experiment and a robot runs it. An Army funded Rice center on antenna arrays. UT Austin putting a computer science and AI course in the core every undergraduate takes. Houston Methodist putting an imaging AI in front of its radiologists and saying out loud that it is imperfect. Four Texas campuses taking roles in the Energy Department's AI for science program. HELD, TWO, both for reasons the bar exists for. UT Southwestern's 91 percent grading claim, because the page carries no publication date and currency is the whole of what this record promises. The August 31st House Bill 3512 deadline, because the agency that runs it disallows this project's agent for the whole host. THE BACKLOG DID NOT GROW. The primary source share moved from 291 of 363 claims to 320 of 392. TWO CORRECTIONS THIS RUN MADE TO ITS OWN WORK. The record said the UT System board acted and cited the agenda book, which is a document asking a committee to approve something. UT System publishes no minutes for that meeting, so the correction came from a post-meeting report and is now claim tx-2026-0095-c5. Fifteen sentences this run wrote were over the thirty word backstop and were split. TWO THINGS FOUND BY LOOKING RATHER THAN BY A GATE. Forty published county pages say "Outside every metropolitan and micropolitan area", including Harris, Bexar, Tarrant and Travis, because site_build.place_page prints that prose in every non metro branch while the gazetteer the same build reads says otherwise. scripts/site is human owned, so the proposal is in the run record and this run stopped. And docs/ was four days stale when this run found it: the eight items admitted today had no page and 46 links pointed at nothing, with every gate green on it. Rebuilt, and the instinct that predicted it was confirmed against the fault rather than against a fixture.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
